scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.copy:frontend: rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint --prefix backend" "npm run lint --prefix frontend"
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
